_comment: zh_TW texts for the German table kampf_k01b. Keys are the English text; keys with %s or %d are patterns. Kept by hand; check with python3 tools/i18n/check_lang.py zh_TW.

strings.%s's Energy is locked: it gains none thi: %s的能量被鎖住了：本回合得不到能量。
strings.A swipe with whatever lies around. Weak,: 隨手抓起身邊的東西一掃。很弱，但不花能量。
strings.Arts that cost 5 Energy or more cost 1 l: 消耗5點或更多能量的技藝少消耗1點。
strings.Draws one long, slow breath: gains 3 Ene: 緩緩深吸一口氣：獲得3點能量，但步調下降1。
strings.Hands up to %d of its Energy to the ally: 把自己最多%d點能量交給身旁的同伴。
strings.Holds up a mirror to the foe's charge: t: 向對手的充能舉起鏡子：雙方交換能量。
strings.Keepsake. The holder starts every battle: 信物。攜帶者每場戰鬥開始時多2點能量。
strings.Passes up to 3 of its own Energy to the: 把自己最多3點能量交給身旁的同伴。
strings.Snaps the foe's fuse: it gains no Energy: 掐斷對手的引線：本回合結束時對手得不到能量。
strings.Teaches Charge Mirror to any Spirling. N: 教會任何Spirling「充能鏡」。永不耗盡。
strings.Teaches Fuse Snap to any Spirling. Never: 教會任何Spirling「斷線擊」。永不耗盡。
strings.Teaches Long Breath to any Spirling. Nev: 教會任何Spirling「長呼吸」。永不耗盡。
strings.Teaches Scrap Swipe to any Spirling. Nev: 教會任何Spirling「雜物掃擊」。永不耗盡。
strings.Teaches Spark Share to any Spirling. Nev: 教會任何Spirling「火花分享」。永不耗盡。
對手%d回合內得不到能量。
strings.Where it is the place's own field, %s ar: 若這是當地本身的場地，%s技藝少消耗%d點能量。
